prompt: Work out the file name and local-repository path Maven gives an artifact. Complete MavenArtifactPaths, then run the tests.
explanation: Maven builds every name from the same three coordinates, so jarFileName is the single place that knows the pattern and repositoryPath reuses it instead of repeating it. String.replace('.', '/') turns a dotted groupId into the nested folders Maven actually creates under ~/.m2/repository. Treating a null or all-space classifier the same way avoids emitting a stray trailing dash like "my-app-1.0.0-.jar".
hints: Build the common part artifactId + "-" + version once, then decide whether a "-" + classifier goes on before ".jar".
String has a replace(char, char) method -- groupId.replace('.', '/') does the whole conversion in one call.
repositoryPath ends with exactly the string jarFileName already produces, so call it rather than rebuilding the name.
